research.name: SSGOI
research.note: Page transition library that gives web apps native-style drill, sheet, zoom and film navigation using the Web Animations API.

effects: zoom page transition where the detail page unfolds from the tapped thumbnail while the list blurs out
sheet transition that slides a page up over a blurred, dimmed previous page
drill transition that slides the next page in over the previous one like native stack navigation
film transition that shrinks the page into a framed strip and scrolls to the next scene
spring physics precomputed into Web Animations API keyframes instead of the View Transition API
